universalcompression.config.general.blac: Mod IDs or full block IDs that are never compressed, e.g. 'create' or 'minecraft:tnt'.
universalcompression.config.general.excl: Mod IDs whose blocks are never compressed, e.g. 'create'.
Full block IDs that are never compressed, e.g. 'minecraft:tnt'.
universalcompression.config.general.whit: Full block IDs that are always compressed, overriding every blacklist rule. Example: blacklist a whole mod, then whitelist 'xycraft_world:kivi'.
universalcompression.config.general.enab: Turns the exact-namespace blacklist on or off.
universalcompression.config.general.blac: Mod IDs to blacklist by exact match.
universalcompression.config.general.enab: Turns the namespace-contains blacklist on or off.
universalcompression.config.general.blac: Blacklists any namespace containing one of these substrings (case-sensitive).
universalcompression.config.general.enab: Turns the namespace-prefix blacklist on or off.
universalcompression.config.general.blac: Blacklists any namespace starting with one of these prefixes.
universalcompression.config.general.enab: Turns the block-path blacklist on or off.
universalcompression.config.general.blac: Blacklists any block whose path contains one of these substrings, e.g. 'torch'.
universalcompression.config.general.hide: Hides all compressed items from the JEI ingredient list. They stay available in the creative tab.
universalcompression.config.general.show: Show Compress Recipes in Recipe Book
Shows 3x3 compression recipes in the crafting book. Recipes stay craftable when hidden.
Show Decompress Recipes in Recipe Book
Shows decompression recipes in the crafting book. Recipes stay craftable when hidden.
